thread:
jess: FYI customer hit a weird rerank failure after they swapped embedding models in their pipeline. Reports: all docs get ~0.0 scores. Asking for repro.
harry: Hi — customer here. We switched doc embeddings from "standard-embed-v1" to "fast-embed-v2" yesterday. Query embeddings still using "standard-embed-v1". After change, rerank returns near-zero scores for every doc. request_id=req_0a1b2c3d.
jess: Oof, that sounds like an embedding-dimension/signature issue. Can you paste a minimal request body and the dims you observe?
harry: Minimal payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "query_embedding": [0.012, -0.034, ...],
  "doc_embeddings": [
    [0.002, 0.111, ...],
    [0.003, -0.021, ...]
  ],
  "top_k": 5
}
```
I measured lengths: query_embedding length = 1536, doc_embeddings[0] length = 768.
support-bot: Automated check: rerank API did not validate embedding vector lengths for mixed inputs. (rule: lengths must match) :warning:
jess: That explains the near-zero scores. If dims mismatch we multiply elementwise or dot prod silently producing garbage or 0 if truncated. We should return 400 with a clear message.
mike: @jess can you confirm whether the customer used our embed API for both, or they passed embeddings generated externally?
harry: They used our embed endpoint for docs with model=fast-embed-v2 and our embed endpoint for queries with model=standard-embed-v1. They then POSTed the arrays to /rerank.
sarah: Are both models still in the catalog? Is fast-embed-v2 an upgraded model with 768 dims while standard is 1536?
mike: Yes — fast-embed-v2 is a compact 768-dim quantized model we introduced last quarter; standard-embed-v1 is 1536. Mixing will cause silent incompatibility currently.
jess: Repro steps for engineering: 1) call /embed model=fast-embed-v2 on a doc -> 768-dim vector 2) call /embed model=standard-embed-v1 on a query -> 1536-dim vector 3) call /rerank with these arrays -> observe low/zero similarity scores and no validation error. Include request_id=req_0a1b2c3d and timestamp.
mike: I can reproduce locally. Quick debug log from rerank service: 
```
INFO  [rerank] received request req_0a1b2c3d
DEBUG [rerank] query_len=1536 doc0_len=768
WARN  [rerank] embedding length mismatch: proceeding with zip/truncate -> results likely invalid
```
We should never silently truncate/zip.
jess: Customer impact: results irrelevant; likely P2 (breaks core ranking). Customer is on Dedicated with SLA.
harry: They're blocked; had to roll back to old ingest pipeline. They want a fix or clear error.
eng-ml-oncall: Escalating to runtime/validation owners. Proposed fixes: 1) server-side validation: return 400 with message "embedding length mismatch: query=1536 doc=768; ensure same embed model/shape" 2) console/SDK: when passing model names to embed&rerk, warn if model families differ 3) short-term: add a migration doc describing mapping/projection options.
mike: I'll open an internal ticket and add a short hotfix to return 400. Ticket: RERANK-1472. Assigning to eng-runtime.
sarah: Also flag docs to do better UX in Console; add a warning on mixed-model pipelines for embeddings.
jess: Action items for support: inform customer that we've identified the cause (mixed embedding dimensions), deploy hotfix to validate inputs and provide workaround (re-embed with same model or use projection). Offer credits for downtime.
harry: Thanks — appreciate the quick triage. Can you cc me when the hotfix lands?
jess: Will do. @mike @eng-ml-oncall please post PR/rollout ETA here. :eyes:
mike: PR created, will roll to staging in ~2h, prod in ~1d pending QA. Linking PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/2435
eng-ml-oncall: Noted. Once prod fix is live we'll follow up with customer and close.
jess: Closing loop here after deploy. For record, include suggested error text in ticket: "400 Bad Request: embedding dimension mismatch (query=1536, doc=768). Ensure embeddings were produced by the same model family or re-run embed step with consistent model."
harry: Got it, thanks all.
